notablePrerequisites:
You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}{R}.
An additional
description:
During an opponent's turn, cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
In response, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Reset.
Allow the Reset copy to resolve, untapping your lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If your lands can produce at least one additional mana, this combo produces infinite mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Nivix Guildmage's abilities any number of times.
